column1: # Package manifest for the remote desktop installer (Debian 13 "trixie").
#   id  layer  method  target  label  description  tags
# layer:  base (always installed) | desktop | dev | creative | ai
#   apt     target = Debian package name(s), space separated; "a|b" = the first alternative this system has
#   mise    target = tool@version, installed globally with `mise use -g`
#   script  target = <binary-to-check>::<shell command>   (skipped if the binary exists)
# (an empty tags field must say `none` when a fallback follows: a tab is whitespace for `read`, so empty fields collapse)
# fallback (optional, eighth field): flatpak:<Flathub app id>, used for an apt row when this system's archive does not have the package (Ubuntu: Chromium)
# tags (comma separated): default = pre-ticked in its layer; gpu = needs a GPU to be pleasant;
#   x86only = hidden by the wizard on arm64 machines
# Names are not verified against trixie yet: run `./install.sh --check`.
